system.description: Triggers mass panic-flight in an already-agitated crowd of roughly 50+ mortals. Make a Static Social Challenge against a Trait total equal to the highest Willpower in the crowd; the Stampede affects everyone within 50 yards, extendable another 50 yards per additional Social Trait spent. Targets at or below half the Gangrel's Social Trait total succumb automatically; targets at or above half may spend a Willpower Trait to resist with a Static Social Challenge against the Gangrel's total; targets whose Willpower equals or exceeds the Gangrel's Social Trait total may make the same resistance test without spending Willpower.
